_comment: Public endpoints probed by scripts/uptime-check.mjs on a schedule.
This replaces the availability monitoring that lived in the
jasperfordesq-ai/api.project-nexus.net repository, which was archived on
2026-08-10. Archiving a repository disables its scheduled workflows, so
the ASP.NET API and Web UK frontend silently lost their only automated
Every entry MUST be an unauthenticated GET against a public URL. Do not
add an endpoint that requires a credential, mutates state, or is not
already public - this file is committed to a PUBLIC repository.
'track' groups an endpoint by deployment: 'production' is the live
Laravel/React platform; 'experimental' is the ASP.NET backend and the Web
UK frontend, which are live on their own domains but are development-only
as far as this repository's deploy scripts are concerned.
